name: SteelSeries Apex M750
description: Per-key lighting of the SteelSeries Apex M750 keyboard (USB 1038:0616). Adapted from OpenRGB's SteelSeriesApexMController and RGBController_SteelSeriesApex (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Only OpenRGB's enable-LED-control and colour reports are sent. The numeric-pad slots are fed from the keys their OpenRGB labels name (OpenRGB's own table is offset by five LEDs there; see the notes). Protocol notes: docs/hardware/steelseries-apex-m.md.
